name: Asymmetric Menu Trees
description: Lets a single translated menu render a different tree structure (parent, order, enabled state, link URL) per language instead of one shared symmetric tree.
project_description: Asymmetric menu trees. The menu system in Drupal core lets you translate menus for different languages in two ways: create a single menu for all languages and translate the terms, or create different menus for different languages. This module deals with the shortcomings of the first way. One major shortcoming is that the structure of a menu tree is fixed — you cannot change the weight, enabled state or link URL of the menu links in a tree per language, so the tree stays 'symmetric' in all languages. This module makes menu trees asymmetric by allowing the weight, enabled state, link URL and parent of menu links to differ per language.
